requirements.quote: Scaffold the static Next app in apps/site if absent (Cloudflare Pages)

add app/status/page.tsx (static shell + client fetch of status.json with HMAC verification, 'Status data could not be verified', stale >5 min warning, fallback 'Status unavailable, retry', skeleton, empty 'All systems operational', offline)
components overall-banner, component-row, uptime-strip, incident-list, subscribe-links (+ stories)
app/status/history/page.tsx and app/status/feed.xml/route.ts (RSS and Atom sanitised like the JSON)
Text+icon status, live region, IST and UTC timestamps, light and dark.
Depends on sub-issue 1 for the snapshot schema.

deliverables.change: Browser-safe zod mirror of core's statusSnapshotSchema (same fields/limits as packages/core/src/status/model.ts), COURT label, STALE_AFTER_SEC=300, component display copy keyed by id
canonicalJson (identical algorithm to publish.ts canonicalStatusJson) and async verifySnapshot(snapshot,key) using crypto.subtle HMAC-SHA256 with constant-time compare; no node: imports

Pure loader: loadStatus(fetch, url, key, now) -> {kind:'ok'|'stale'|'unverified'|'unavailable'|'empty'}; stale when now-generatedAt>300s; unverified on bad schema or signature; unavailable on network/HTTP error; empty (no incidents, all operational) renders 'All systems operational'; offline detection hook helper
formatIst/formatUtc timestamps (Asia/Kolkata and UTC, Intl), uptime-strip day buckets derived from incidents over INCIDENT_WINDOW (30 days), status label+icon name maps
buildRss and buildAtom from a verified snapshot: XML-escape every field, only allowlisted fields, empty feed for unverified/unavailable data

Tests: fixture signed with a known key matches core's output byte-for-byte; tampered body/signature rejected; stale at 301s and not at 300s; all state kinds; IST/UTC strings; feed escaping (<, &, CDATA end, control chars) and RSS+Atom well-formed; court wording

'use client' view: fetches via loadStatus in useEffect, skeleton, retry button ('Status unavailable, retry'), unverified Alert ('Status data could not be verified'), stale warning, offline notice (online/offline events), aria-live=polite region for status changes
Overall banner: icon + text (never colour alone), 'All systems operational' empty state, role=status
Component row with icon+text state, localised-by-id name (court = 'Parsing of documents you share')
30-day strip with per-day text alternative (accessible list), not colour only
Incident list with updates, each timestamp in IST and UTC via <time>
Links to /status/feed.xml (RSS) and /status/atom.xml (Atom)
Stories for the five components and status-view states (operational, degraded, down, stale, unverified, unavailable, skeleton, empty), light and dark via existing theme class

jsdom render tests (// @vitest-environment jsdom): text+icon, aria-live, IST+UTC, retry, unverified and stale copy. Only if jsdom/@testing-library are added (see K3); otherwise use react-dom/server renderToString in node and drop jsdom
Static shell (metadata via pageMetadata, h1) rendering StatusView; no data at build
History page: same client fetch, shows resolved incidents (30 days) with IST/UTC
export const dynamic='force-static'; GET returns RSS 2.0 (application/rss+xml) built at build time from verified status.json (empty feed when unavailable)
force-static GET returning Atom 1.0 (application/atom+xml) from the same builder

Add NEXT_PUBLIC_STATUS_URL (default '/status/status.json', absolute https or root-relative) and NEXT_PUBLIC_STATUS_VERIFY_KEY (default DEV status key string) to siteEnvSchema/readSiteEnv/siteEnv, empty counts as unset
baseCsp connect-src also allows the origin of NEXT_PUBLIC_STATUS_URL when absolute
Add 'Status' link (/status/) in a footer column
Add /status and /status/history entries
Document the two new env vars, the verify-key caveat and the build-time feed refresh

Only if K3 is taken: add @storybook/nextjs-vite, storybook (catalog:) devDependencies and storybook scripts, plus apps/site/.storybook/{main,preview}.ts and pnpm-lock.yaml update; no new workspace-package dependency

preserve.what: packages/core/src/status/* (model, canonical JSON, signing) stay unchanged; the site mirrors them and must stay byte-compatible
apps/site stays a pure static export: no middleware, rewrites, headers() or async redirects (apps/site/src/site-scaffold.test.ts:24-33)
CSP stays script-hash based with no inline-script allowance (apps/site/scripts/write-headers.ts); existing buildHeaders signature and output for current inputs unchanged
Rule 36 copy lint (apps/site/scripts/rule36-lint.ts) must pass on all new copy
Existing env defaults and readSiteEnv behaviour in apps/site/lib/env.ts

validate.command: pnpm --filter @causedeck/site exec vitest run lib/status src/site-scaffold.test.ts
node /opt/node/lib/node_modules/forgedock/bin/lean/checks.mjs --base origin/milestone/site-onboarding-launch  # then run the scoped typecheck/test/lint commands it prints

decisions.choice: Mirror the snapshot schema and canonical-JSON/HMAC logic inside apps/site/lib/status instead of importing @causedeck/core/status
decisions.justification: core's publish.ts imports node:crypto and the core package pulls db/storage (packages/core/src/status/publish.ts:1-34); apps/site depends only on @causedeck/ui (apps/site/package.json:25-33), and a workspace dependency on core would need an architecture-doc reason. Drift is guarded by a test fixture signed by core's algorithm (D6).

decisions.choice: HMAC verification with a public NEXT_PUBLIC_STATUS_VERIFY_KEY via WebCrypto; document that it proves integrity against corruption, not against a forger who can read the key
decisions.justification: The issue prescribes client-side HMAC verification of the HS256 snapshot (packages/core/src/status/model.ts:55-61); the site has no secrets (apps/site/README.md:4, lib/env.ts:1-2).

decisions.choice: Stories: write CSF stories next to the components; add a site Storybook (devDeps, .storybook) only if it can be done without a new workspace package. If not, keep stories typed with a local minimal Meta type and note that the runner is a follow-up
decisions.justification: apps/site has no Storybook today; packages/ui/.storybook/main.ts and apps/web/.storybook show the config; Storybook never runs locally (CLAUDE.md).

decisions.choice: Feed routes read status.json at build time (force-static) and degrade to an empty verified-only feed; add a sibling atom.xml route since a route.ts yields one content type
decisions.justification: Static export has no runtime (apps/site/next.config.ts:9-10); pattern at apps/site/app/robots.ts:5. Feed freshness depends on rebuilds (documented in D23).

decisions.choice: Use @causedeck/ui badge, alert, skeleton, card subpaths; no new dependency
decisions.justification: Existing exports in packages/ui/package.json; already a site dependency (apps/site/package.json:25).
